notes: Right half of 1922 vol 1 plate 26. Two frames: the MAIN map (Lower Price Hill, y < ~3800) and a separate INSET of West Price Hill along W. 8th Street (y > ~4250: Nebraska, Doll, Fisher, Pedretti, Hermosa, Schiff, Kreis, Trenton, Amelia/Carnation, Foley Road); every pick carries part main/inset and the two must be georeferenced separately (the inset's W. 8th is a different, more westerly stretch of W. 8th, Nebraska to Trenton). Across the gutter R x ~ L x - 5550 (approximate, distorted near the fold), so picks with R x < ~650 also appear on 22-26L. Gutter-strip picks (also on 22-26L), main map: ?/W. 8th (245,356), State/W. 8th (492,349), State/Pardee (448,640), Oswaldt/Pardee (633,640), State/Hatmaker (411,883), Oswaldt/Hatmaker north leg (633,880) and south leg (650,879), State/Staebler (359,1225), Neave/Staebler (645,1223), State/Storrs (311,1542), Neave/Storrs (637,1540), State/St. Michael (243,1989), Neave/St. Michael (633,1984), W. Price/State (228,2125), Warsaw/W. Price (177,2295), State/English (217,2385), Neave/English north leg (626,2379) and south leg (596,2379), Neave/W. 6th (596,2945), State/W. 6th (540,3022) (the Oswaldt and Neave points lie at the very right edge of 22-26L); inset: Nebraska/W. 8th (76,4544), Doll/W. 8th (605,4549), Nebraska/Amelia (76,5433), Doll/Amelia (600,5440). Names as printed: STAEBLER (1904 Strebler), STORRS, ST. MICHAEL, ENGLISH, HATMAKER, PARDEE ALLEY, OSWALDT ... ALLEY (OSWALDT printed in the block south of Hatmaker, ALLEY in the block north of it), NEAVE, CHURCH ST., BURNS, DEPOT ST., EVANS, PERIN AVE., W. SIXTH (printed '... STREET' on the diagonal and 'W. SI(XTH) ST.' east of Evans), CHANNEL ST., STATE, WARSAW, W. PRICE AVE. (old Price Hill Road), W. EIGHTH. Inset: NEBRASKA AVE., DOLL ... AVE. (N-S street printed 'AVE.' north of Amelia and 'DOLL' south of it; the E-W leg printed DOLL AVE.), FISHER AVE., PEDRETTI ... AVE. ('AVE.' near W. 8th, 'PEDRETTI' near Foley Road), HERMOSA ST., SCHIFF AVE., KREIS AVE., TRENTON (AVE.), AMELIA AVE., CARNATION AVE., FLOWER AVE., VINEYARD AVE., FRANCIS AVE., GREEN HILL PL. PRIVATE; the road along the city limits is printed only 'ROAD' on this half and 'FOLEY' on 22-26L, recorded as Foley Road. No bracketed old names seen. Unnamed (?): the road north of W. 8th at the gutter corner (unnamed on 22-29 too) and the inset's SW-NE diagonal road between Trenton/Francis and Foley Road. Faces are the lot lines; on this plate the house numbers, and coloured (yellow, blue, teal) strips carrying them, lie inside the street next to the face, and solid lines inside streets are water pipes (dashed: sewers). State Avenue: ~85 px (53 ft) between faces, tracks in the street; east face x = 515 - 0.152(y-480) down to St. Michael, then x~265 to English and ~251 along block 26 (small jog at English), then SE to W. 6th. The X at the gutter: a narrow island (lots 77, 78) separates Warsaw (from NNW) from State; south of its tip (~190,2272) Warsaw, State's west side and W. Price (to SSW) merge. W. Price/State and Warsaw/W. Price are taken where the centrelines meet (both ~15-20 px uncertain). A teal strip runs along Warsaw's west side and on south along State's west side (not a street). W. 6th diagonal (State to Evans) has tracks along its south side and no clean south face; its centreline is taken 30 ft (48 px) from the north block faces, as on 22-3L (a track/double line runs close to that centre between Neave and Church). Church and English: the block SW of the Church/English crossing has its NE corner where English's south face, Church's west face and the W. 6th north face meet; south of English at Church there is only the merged English/W. 6th roadway, and English merges into W. 6th at the corner cut of block 29 (x~1455-1585). Burns: ~62 px (39 ft) between faces (a water pipe line runs ~23 px inside the west face). Channel St. does not reach Evans. Evans: 60 ft north of W. 6th, ~100 px south of it with a teal strip inside the east face. Railroads, the creek and the canal bed ignored.
